CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is South Coastal Regency
2. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of South Coastal.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of South Coastal Regency.
5. Regional Apparatus Organization hereinafter abbreviated as OPD is the Regional Apparatus Working Unit in the Regional Government of South Coastal Regency.
6. Women's Empowerment is an effort of Protection, strengthening of human rights, improvement of quality of life, and increase of women's participation in development.
7. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including those in the womb.
8. Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence and/or threats of violence that include physical, sexual, psychological, economic and/or social violence, in the family, community and/or society, in conflict situations, post-conflict, and state.
9. Protection of women is all efforts to guarantee and protect the rights of women so that they can live healthily and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and obtain protection from neglect, violence and discrimination, whether in the form of preventive, repressive or post-remedial protection (assistance and treatment).
10. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate, optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive Protection from Violence and discrimination.
11. Gender Mainstreaming is a strategy built to integrate gender into an integral dimension of planning, formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of national development program policies.
12. Prevention is direct efforts carried out by the Regional Government, community and parents and/or family to prevent violations of the rights of women and Children.
13. Gender responsive is consistent and systematic attention to the differences between women and men in society accompanied by efforts to eliminate structural and cultural barriers in achieving gender equality.
14. Focal Point for Gender Mainstreaming is a Regional Apparatus Organization official who has the ability to carry out gender mainstreaming in their respective work units.
15. Recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of violence to be more empowered, whether physically, psychologically, socially, economically, culturally and politically.
16. Violence is any act and/or threat of act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, psychological, sexual or neglect.
17. Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.
18. Violence against Children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
19. Gender Equality is equal conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings in playing roles and participating in all fields.
20. Gender Justice is fair treatment of women and men, so that the ability to identify gaps in power relations between women and men in the family and in the community, the impact of gender-based division of labor on women and men, and the experiences, problems, needs, interests and aspirations of women and men are different.
21. Service is action that must be immediately taken for victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
22. Safe House is temporary housing used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
23. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband, wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
24. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or step father and/or mother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
25. Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
26. Children's Forum is a forum for Child participation formed with the aim of facilitating the involvement of Children in decision-making processes and enjoying changes relating to their lives either directly or indirectly, which is carried out with the consent and will of all Children based on awareness and understanding, in accordance with age and level of thinking maturity.
27. Child-Friendly Regency hereinafter abbreviated as KLA is a Regency that has a Child rights-based development system through the integration of government commitment and resources, community and business world that is planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of Child rights.
28. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is an institution established by the regional government to provide services to women and children experiencing criminal and civil problems.
